# Validation Test Case: TemplateServiceClient Delegation

## Input
```json
{
  "file": "repos/metabob-opencode/packages/opencode/src/server/template-service-client.ts",
  "check": "TemplateServiceClient delegates to MetabobCLI"
}
```

## Expected Output
```json
{
  "fileExists": true,
  "callsSearchActivities": true,
  "callsGetActivity": true,
  "callsRegisterActivityTemplate": true
}
```

## Test Description
This test case validates that TemplateServiceClient delegates to MetabobCLI meets the specification requirements for Activity Template Flow via MCP Backend.

## Validation Type
Static code analysis - no LLM required
